spec.sql: WITH rate AS (SELECT CAST(json_extract_string(state,'$.rate') AS DECIMAL(18,6)) AS r FROM objects WHERE object_type = 'fx_rate' AND json_extract_string(state,'$.base') = 'EUR' AND json_extract_string(state,'$.quote') = 'PLN' ORDER BY json_extract_string(state,'$.date') DESC LIMIT 1), ic AS (SELECT DISTINCT root_event_id FROM objects WHERE object_type = 'purchase_invoice'), p AS (SELECT json_extract_string(a.state,'$.code') AS code, json_extract_string(a.state,'$.name') AS account, json_extract_string(o.state,'$.side') AS side, CASE WHEN json_extract_string(o.state,'$.currency') = 'EUR' THEN CAST(json_extract(o.state,'$.amount') AS BIGINT) ELSE CAST(round(CAST(json_extract(o.state,'$.amount') AS BIGINT) / (SELECT r FROM rate)) AS BIGINT) END AS eur FROM objects o JOIN objects a ON json_extract_string(o.state,'$.account') = a.object_id WHERE o.object_type = 'posting' AND a.object_type = 'account' AND NOT (o.root_event_id IN (SELECT root_event_id FROM ic) AND json_extract_string(a.state,'$.type') <> 'tax')), sums AS (SELECT code, account, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'debit' THEN eur ELSE 0 END),0) AS d, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'credit' THEN eur ELSE 0 END),0) AS c FROM p GROUP BY 1, 2), rows_ AS (SELECT code, account, d, c FROM sums UNION ALL SELECT 'CTA', 'Translation difference', CASE WHEN s < 0 THEN -s ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN s > 0 THEN s ELSE 0 END FROM (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d),0) - COALESCE(SUM(c),0) AS s FROM sums) t WHERE s <> 0) SELECT code, account, d AS debit, c AS credit, d - c AS balance FROM rows_ ORDER BY code

SELECT CAST(root AS VARCHAR) AS root_event, r AS receivable, pay AS payable, abs(r - pay) AS difference FROM (SELECT o.root_event_id AS root, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract_string(a.state,'$.type') = 'debtor' THEN COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(o.state,'$.tx_amount') AS BIGINT), CAST(json_extract(o.state,'$.amount') AS BIGINT)) ELSE 0 END),0) AS r, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract_string(a.state,'$.type') = 'creditor' THEN COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(o.state,'$.tx_amount') AS BIGINT), CAST(json_extract(o.state,'$.amount') AS BIGINT)) ELSE 0 END),0) AS pay FROM objects o JOIN objects a ON json_extract_string(o.state,'$.account') = a.object_id WHERE o.object_type = 'posting' AND a.object_type = 'account' AND o.root_event_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT root_event_id FROM objects WHERE object_type = 'purchase_invoice') GROUP BY 1) t ORDER BY root
